high_high.label: CRITICAL high value
high_high.helper: A limit beyond “too high”: for urgent alarms.

low_low.label: CRITICAL low value
low_low.helper: A limit beyond “too low”: for urgent alarms.

comm_loss.label: Communication lost (PLC not answering)
comm_loss.helper: Fires when no valid reading arrives for the time set below.

frozen.label: Value frozen (sensor or PLC stuck)
frozen.helper: Readings arrive but the value does not move for the time set below. Useful on a watchdog counter.
